data: What is the approximate value of the purple triangle marker at 550 hours of supervised data?

The question asks for the approximate value of the purple triangle marker at 550 hours of supervised data. The figure shows two lines representing different conditions: one for "Sup/RS + Unsup" and another for "Sup/AL + Unsup". The purple line represents "Sup/RS + Unsup", and the blue line represents "Sup/AL + Unsup". The purple triangle marker is located on the purple line. At approximately 550 hours of supervised data, the purple triangle marker is positioned near the 12.4% mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the purple triangle marker at 550 hours of supervised data is 12.4%.
